entities.summary: Jordan Harris is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the third round, 71st overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2018 NHL entry draft. Harris has also previously played for the Columbus Blue Jackets.
